title: DerivativeManifest
description: Idempotency + verify-by-record manifest emitted by tools/image-optimize. Maps every optimized source raster to its derivative by sha256 so re-runs are a no-op and a deploy preflight can verify by record instead of re-deriving. S0 = foundation fields; S1 adds OPTIONAL policy fields (tier, target_width, quality, has_alpha, downscaled) and OPTIONAL avif/png_fallback sub-records produced by the format/sizing policy engine.

schema.description: Schema version tag. Bump on any breaking field change.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the manifest file was last written.

entries.description: One entry per optimized source file.

source_path.description: Path to the source raster, relative to the manifest's base (or absolute). The idempotency key together with source_sha256.

source_sha256.description: Lowercase hex sha256 of the source file bytes. Skip-by-source-hash key.

derivative_path.description: Path to the produced derivative (e.g. the .webp).

derivative_sha256.description: Lowercase hex sha256 of the derivative file bytes.

encoder.description: Adapter id that produced the derivative (e.g. cwebp, sharp).

encoder_version.description: Version string reported by the encoder at run time, or 'unknown' if not resolvable.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the derivative was produced. Supplied by the caller so runs are stampable and tests stay deterministic.

tier.description: S1: sizing tier applied (selects the max-width + byte caps).

target_width.description: S1: the width the source was resized to (never above source width — no upscale).

has_alpha.description: S1: whether the produced WebP carries an alpha channel (mechanically detected from the source).

downscaled.description: S1: true if the source width exceeded the tier cap and was downscaled; false if kept at source width.

avif.description: S1: OPTIONAL additional AVIF derivative (--also-avif). Never the sole asset.

png_fallback.description: S1: OPTIONAL quantized-PNG retain derivative for alpha sources (pngquant). Absent when pngquant is unavailable; the alpha-WebP remains the default asset.
